This ffmpeg lacks required encoders (libx264={libx264}, aac={aac}), so it cannot produce compatible MP4 files.
Install the official static build: winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg -e

faster-whisper was not found, so subtitles cannot be generated.

Install the dependencies once (about 200 MB):

"{exe}" -m pip install faster-whisper sherpa-onnx
